name: OptionStrike
description: Defines the strike price of an option.

averagingStrikeFeature.description: Defines an  option strike that is calculated from an average of observed market prices.

referenceSwapCurve.description: Defines the strike of an option when expressed by reference to a swap curve (Typically the case for a convertible bond option).

strikePrice.description: Defines the strike of an option in the form of a price that could be a cash price, interestRate, or other types.

strikeReference.description: Defines the strike of an option in reference to the spread of the underlying swap (typical practice in the case of an option on a credit single name swaps).
